external_result.reason:
Design chosen only from the permitted typed fields (capacitance_f=2.2e-5 F = component_record id 260 cap_voltage_max-compatible value; tx_not_before_s=0, i.e. earliest legal transmit). Everything else is fixed by component_record/excitation_record b-pulse-fast and model_law b-transient-behavior-v1.

Source-bound derivation: excitation_record gives one segment 7.5 mW over 0-0.02 s with harvest_efficiency 0.9 (component_record), i.e. ~135 uJ total available and 6.75 mW charging; deadline_s=0.1; event at t=0 with contact 0.008 s held by the passive-mechanical latch (latch scope: capture at zero stored energy, persists through reset). Component values give packet cost = 1.8 V x 8 mA x 2 ms = 28.8 uJ per 2 ms frame, and thresholds eon=3.92*C, eoff=1.62*C, loaded_v = sqrt(2E/C) - esr*I >= 1.8 V. With C=22 uF, eon=86.2 uJ is reached at ~12.9 ms, inside the 20 ms harvest window; charging that late is the binding constraint on C, and 22 uF (~6.73 mW charging, ~12.9 ms to eon) leaves a 4x margin to the 100 ms deadline. Smaller C (e.g. 4 uF, eon reached in ~2.3 ms) holds only ~17 uJ at Tx start while Tx nets about -15.3 uJ, so it would fall below eoff/loaded_v and brown out; hence the high end of the legal range is selected rather than the low.

Observation (check record, b-transient-behavior-v1, dt 1e-4, 10000 steps, independent Decimal ledger): boot at 0.0129 s, tx-start 0.0139 s, tx-complete 0.0158 s, exactly one received frame (hex 010400010101b0260657, event_id 1) at 0.0158 s with loaded_v 2.5817 V > 1.8 V, tx_j 2.88e-5 J, spill_j 0, ledger max_balance_error 1e-20 and step_count 10000. Gates: independent energy (harvested 1.35e-4 J > boot+background+tx), one valid source event frame, causal capture after the t=0 press, deadline 0.0158 s < 0.1 s, deduplication (single packet; done flag stops further Tx), voltage feasibility (loaded_v and cap_voltage_max respected, zero spill). The only brownout is at 0.3395 s, long after the deadline and with event_was_captured=false, so it does not affect the delivered frame.

Retained limits: I did not receive the per-step trace, only activity, packet and ledger aggregates, so I make no claim about a complete unprojected step-by-step trace. physical_qualification and source_calibration are UNKNOWN, and the latch is an ideal passive-mechanical assumption, not ECO260 hardware; no hardware, transfer, statistical or self-improvement claim follows. Only one distinct candidate was checked; the judgment PASS applies to this frozen digital service, with final acceptance determined host-side.
